verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents several first-party ways to act on many resources as a group. Node Pools manage any number of Nodes under one shared configuration (labels, taints, annotations) and scale them together via the Cluster Autoscaler. The Terraform provider manages clusters, VPCs, buckets and inference resources declaratively. Bucket lifecycle policies apply expiration and cleanup across a bucket's objects. However, the evidence shows no explicit batch or bulk API endpoint and no multi-select bulk actions in the console, so bulk operation is implied by group-level abstractions rather than documented as a feature. missing for 10: explicit batch/bulk API operations (e.g., multi-object delete or bulk resource updates), console bulk actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
